title: Demo - HelioHealth Notes Summarization
summary: Demo of chat + embeddings. Customer focused on HIPAA posture and BAAs; no explicit data residency constraints raised.
next_steps: Follow up on BAA process timeline
transcript:
Meeting: Demo - HelioHealth Notes Summarization
Date: 2025-02-06
Duration: 33 min

[00:00] Avery (Redwood): Hey all, Ill do a quick run through of the console and API.
[00:08] Priya (HelioHealth): Sounds good.

[01:12] Nate (HelioHealth): Our main thing is HIPAA. We have PHI. Can you sign a BAA?
[01:20] Avery: For enterprise plans, yes, we have a standard BAA we can work from.
[01:30] Dev (Redwood): And you can configure retention. Also we support customer-managed keys in certain modes.

[04:05] Priya: We do summarization of clinical notes and then a chat interface for clinicians.
[04:22] Dev: Okay. Context lengths, do you need like 32k or more like 8k?

[07:50] Nate: Reliability is big. What happens if the model endpoint is down?
[08:02] Avery: We have fallbacks and error budgets; for Dedicated you get SLA-backed uptime.

[12:10] Priya: Do you log prompts?
[12:14] Dev: By default we log minimal request metadata. Prompt logging can be disabled; for Private its your logging stack.

[20:30] Nate: Cool. Pricing wise wed like a ballpark.
[20:37] Avery: Ill follow up with ranges based on tokens and whether you want Dedicated.

[32:10] Avery: Next steps: Ill send security docs, and we can talk through BAA.
